kinepage.message: Amir and Kaya messing with radio. May affect your time. Sorry. A.

translations.fr: Amir et Kaya s'amusent avec la radio. Cela pourrait perturber le temps. Désolé. A.
translations.it: Amir e Kaya stanno giocando con la radio. Potrebbe influire sul tempo. Mi dispiace. A.
translations.de: Amir und Kaya spielen mit dem Radio rum. Das könnte deine Zeit beeinflussen. Entschuldigung. A.
translations.es: Amir y Kaya están jugando con la radio. Esto puede afectar tu tiempo. Una disculpa. A.
translations.pt: O Amir e a Kaya estão mexendo no rádio, isso pode afetar sua conexão. Foi mal.
translations.ru: Амир и Кайя вмешиваются в работу радио. Это может повлиять на ваше время. Извините. А.
translations.pl: Amir i Kaya majstrują przy radiu. To może wpłynąć na twój czas. Sorry. A.
translations.uk: Амір і Кая граються з радіо. Це може впливати на ваш час. Вибачайте. А.
translations.tr: Amir ve Kaya radyoyla uğraşıyor. Bu, zaman kavramını etkileyebilir. Özür dilerim. A.
translations.ja: AmirとKayaがラジオをハイジャックした。時空に歪みができるかもしれない。すまない。-Arthur
translations.zh: 阿米尔和卡娅在摆弄收音机。这可能会影响到你的时间。抱歉。——亚瑟留。
translations.ko: 아미르와 카야가 라디오로 장난질을 치고 있군. 네 시간에도 영향이 갈 지도 모른다. 미안하다. A.
translations.tc: 阿米爾和卡婭在亂搞無線電，可能會干擾到你的時間。抱歉了。－亞瑟。
translations.th: Amir กับ Kaya กำลังปรับแต่งสัญญาณวิทยุอยู่ ซึ่งอาจส่งผลกระทบต่อเวลา ต้องขออภัยด้วย จาก A.

deviation.name: Sealed Armor
deviation.description: Enemies take 90% less damage from non-Weak Point hits.

risks.name: Bold Venture
risks.description: Enemies deal -15% Damage and take +15% Damage but gain +15% Movement Speed, Attack Speed, and Fire Rate.

risks.name: Alluring Arcocanids
risks.description: As Rogue Arcocanids charge attacks, they pull Warframes towards them.

risks.name: Fortified Foes
risks.description: Guardian Eximus units may be encountered, including Guardian Eximus Necramechs.

risks.name: Postmortal Surges
risks.description: Slain enemies burts with Void energy.

deviation.name: Unified Purpose
deviation.description: Enemies can target and destroy Conduits.

risks.name: Entanglement
risks.description: Allies within 4m of slain enemies endure reduced Movement Speed and Parkour Velocity.

risks.name: Commanding Culverins
risks.description: Rogue Culverins equip weapons that deal 5x Damage to Overguard and Necramechs.

personalModifiers.name: Dropped Guard
personalModifiers.description: Warframe and ally Overguard gain reduced by 75%.

personalModifiers.name: Secondary Wounds
personalModifiers.description: Gain 1 Puncture Status Effect every time you take damage.

deviation.name: Pile-On
deviation.description: Techrot enemies attempt to melee attack Hell-Scrubbers, bursting on contact and increasing scrubber contamination by 25%.

risks.name: Corrupted Flesh
risks.description: Techrot enemies are infused with Efervon and take damage over time. They explode when killed and leave behind deadly Efervon in their wake.

risks.name: Myopic Munitions
risks.description: Enemies will only take damage if a player is within 15m of them.

deviation.name: Miasmite Mash
deviation.description: Enemies drop Miasmites upon death that immediately rush Flare.

risks.name: Miasmite Swarm
risks.description: Techrot Miasmites swarm out of the shadows throught the mission.

risks.name: Bolstered Belligerents
risks.description: All enemies have Overguard equal to 50% of their max health.

deviation.name: Reinforcements
deviation.description: Reinforcements will arrive during the fight.

risks.name: Heavy Warfare
risks.description: Enemies take 95% less damage from non-heavy weapons. Enemies will drop heavy ammo packs and heavy weapon recall time reduced to 5s.

risks.name: Competitive Streak
risks.description: Random negative penalties from Amir and Aoi's "Faceoff" mode will be applied throughout the mission.
